hypothesis: Paired N=256 arm (seeds 65-69, otherwise identical to the N=64 arm: e in [0, 0.5], 4 layers, d_model=64, best-of-5 controls, 5-step checkpoints). At e <= 0.5, accel_step forms later at N=256 than at N=64 for the same seed. Earlier matched seeds give 0.1-bar deltas of +20/+70/+30 (seeds 56-58) and 0/0/+20 (seeds 62-64), and half-final deltas of +20/+10/+30 and +30/+10/+30. Both formation steps are read from the per-checkpoint trajectories.
expected_if_true: The N=256 minus N=64 delay is >= +15 steps on the persistent 0.1-bar measure in at least 4 of 5 new seeds, and >= +15 on the half-final-margin measure in at least 4 of 5. Pooled over all 11 matched seeds (56-58, 62-69), the mean delay is >= +20 on both measures.
expected_if_false: The delay is <= +10 steps on both measures in at least 3 of 5 new seeds, and the pooled 11-seed mean delay is < +10 on the 0.1-bar measure. Any other pattern counts as inconclusive. 5-step checkpoints make differences of 5 steps the resolution limit.
